name: Girls in the Shadow
source:
You're a newly appointed probation officer tasked with reintegrating inmates from the Institute for Criminal Rehabilitation back into society. With crime rates soaring in San Marco, you're assigned not one, but two young women. Don’t be fooled by their charm—they’re here for a reason, and neither is pleased about it.

Yet, neither seems inherently malicious. As you begin to investigate the motives behind their crimes, your findings unravel dark secrets—and a hidden connection between the two...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.youngcrime]Google Play[/url]]
